[1] - Analog distortion. - Three factory voicings are built into the signal path. - No specific commercial clone lineage or component-level schematic is published by CNZ in the reviewed source. - Exact production transistor/device part number is not publicly documented. - Exact clipping-device type and part number are not publicly documented. - **9V DC, center-negative**. - Approximately **10 mA**. - **470 kOhm input impedance**, **470 Ohm output impedance**.
